headlines.title: Luigi Mangione admits to killing CEO
headlines.description: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty in federal court to stalking charges. He also admitted that he shot United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson, but did not express remorse for the crime. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports.

headlines.title: Trump downplays concerns about living conditions on aircraft carrier
headlines.description: President Trump downplayed concerns about living conditions aboard the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez got reaction from the families of sailors on the ship.

headlines.title: Magnitude-7.7 quake hits off coast of Indonesia, killing at least 20
headlines.description: A magnitude-7.7 earthquake hit off the coast of Indonesia in the eastern Flores region, the United States Geological Survey reported on Friday.

headlines.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism, found dead week after resigning
headlines.description: Former Cambridge professor Jason Arday was found dead at his London home on Friday, one week after he resigned from his position after accusations of plagiarism.

headlines.title: Haitians in Maryland live in fear over ICE detentions after end of their TPS status
headlines.description: More than 350,000 Haitians lost Temporary Protected Status as the Trump administration ramps up ICE arrests. In Maryland, a 17-year-old watched how ICE detained her father and a widowed father fears he too will be arrested. NBC News' Yamiche Alcindor reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: What’s next for Democrats — in November and 2027: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, “Meet the Press” moderator Kristen Welker looks at Democrats’ recent primary results and digs into what they might mean for governing next year.

headlines.title: 5 people killed in rural Michigan; suspect found dead
headlines.description: Five people were found dead in rural northern Michigan on Friday, state police said.

headlines.description: Both the violent crime and murder rates have decreased annually since spiking in 2022, the bureau has found. President Donald Trump touted the statistics Friday.
